issues.issue: Is the claimant excluded under Article 1E because of Trinidad permanent residence (three oldest claimants)?
issues.applicant_position: Loss of Trinidad status was valid because they fear returning there; they should not be excluded.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on Article 1E for the three oldest claimants.
issues.result_quote: are excluded pursuant to 1E as per s. 98 of IRPA.

issues.issue: Do the claimants face persecution or risk in Trinidad because of Chinese ethnicity?
issues.applicant_position: Discrimination and violence against Chinese people in Trinidad amount to persecution; they fear returning there.
issues.result_quote: the claimants did not give sufficient credible evidence of persecution in Trinidad

issues.issue: Would the parents and daughter face persecution in China for breaching family planning rules (four children)?
issues.applicant_position: Four children breach family planning; they fear sterilization, fines and denial of hukou in China.
issues.result_quote: there is less than a mere possibility that they would be subject to persecution

issues.issue: Is the principal claimant a genuine Christian, and would his sur place religious claim succeed?
issues.applicant_position: Principal claimant converted to Pentecostal Christianity in Canada and fears persecution in China.
issues.result_quote: the claimant failed to establish his sur place claim with credible, convincing, and cogent evidence
